question: In which year, the Koya rebellion took place in the eastern Godavari tract?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1879-1880.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Koya rebellion** in the **eastern Godavari** tract occurred during the years **1879-80**.
 
• **The Koyas,** who belong to the present-day Andhra Pradesh region, **revolted against** oppression by **police and moneylenders**, 
 
• They rose once again in 1879-80 under **Tomma Sora,**
 
• The Koyas rebelled against the imposition of new regulations by the British Indian Government.
 
• Later, **after Tomma Sora’s death**, another r**ebellion was organized in 1886 by Raja Anantayyar.** 
 
• The** Koya rebellion** was a** fight for the independence of the Koya community** against **colonial powers**' intrusions into their way of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rebellion** refers to **violent action** or a **feeling of strong disagreement** with authority, rules, or established norms.
 
• Throughout history, **rebellions have occurred in response to social, political, and economic injustices.**
 
• The **American Revolution**
 
 
• **​**Colonists rebelled against British rule, leading to the birth of the United States
 
 
 
• **Indian Rebellion of 1857**
 
 
• **​**Also known as the Sepoy Mutiny, it was a significant uprising against British colonial rule in India.
 
 
 
• **French Revolution**
 
 
• **​**A massive rebellion that transformed France’s political landscape and led to the end of the monarchy.
 
 

5b:T
